Capacity deficiency or capacity excess conditions; iii. A fuel shortage requiring departure from normal operating procedures in order to minimize the use of such scarce fuel; iv. An abnormal event external to the ISO service territory that may require ISO action. c. For periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training.
